title: Person assembling a slotted wooden structure
visual_facts: A person holds a narrow slotted wooden structure while using a blue hot glue gun.
A small illuminated sign on the table behind the person reads WiFi!.
A black mallet and a wooden-handled tool lie on the table in front.
Rows of numbered lockers and tall windows are visible in the background.
A projected computer screen is visible on the right wall.
spatial_relations: The person is holding the wooden piece above the table while applying the glue gun near its lower edge.
The illuminated WiFi! sign is behind the person, near the table's back edge.
uncertainties: The wooden structure's purpose is not apparent.
The projected text is too small to read.
